newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Evans says company profits strong.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Evans says company profits strong.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans said on Monday that company profits generally remained at strong levels.
"They (profits) may not be growing as strongly, but they're at quite high levels," Evans told a business economists' luncheon in Sydney.
He said while the manufacturing and housing sectors were showing some weakness both in terms of output and profits, other industries continued to perform well.
"Beyond that, the weakness is not there. It's not there in mining, for example, and it's not there in services."
Evans said the general strength in company profits supported the federal government's forecast of a 14 percent rise in business investment in 1996/97.
The forecast followed growth of 10 percent and 17 percent in the last two years.
"Investment decisions aren't based on this year's profits in any case," he said.
"I do know that when firms make those decisions they look a long way ahead and they look at the soundness of the economy over the medium term."
